card.summary: Apache-2.0 12B distilled to 1-4 steps: fast, commercial-friendly, same strong prompt understanding as dev with slightly lower peak fidelity.
card.pick_when: Fast Flux-quality image, commercial license needed, or quick drafts.

prompt.example: A vibrant Bangkok street-food market at night, neon signs reflecting on wet pavement, steam rising from stalls, crowds, cinematic, highly detailed
prompt.overview: Same natural-language style as FLUX.1-dev but tuned for speed: 1-4 steps, guidance disabled, shorter 256-token window -- keep prompts concise.
prompt.instructions: Same descriptive natural-language style as [dev], but timestep-distilled for 1-4 steps with guidance disabled (guidance_scale 0.0) and a shorter 256-token prompt window -- favor concise, focused prompts. Classifier-free guidance is effectively off, so negatives have no effect. Short in-image text can be included directly. The model may sometimes fail to match the prompt (the speed trade-off).
do: Use concise descriptive natural language + style modifiers
Include short quoted text directly for rendering
examples: Astronaut in a jungle, cold color palette, muted colors, detailed, 8k
A cat holding a sign that says hello world
prompt.negative_guidance: Guidance disabled (CFG off); negatives have no effect.

speed.note: 4 steps; GGUF offload adds some load time.
speed.measured_note: ~22s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 4 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
